authority: Explicit user instruction, followed by revised policy in B4 ROADMAP.md at commit 1133441
promotion: No universal percentage floor. Require stable complete-run benefit, prespecified uncertainty supporting a positive improvement, fresh held-out inputs/repeated seeds, unchanged correctness/resource limits and no more than 5 percentage points completion regression in another declared class. Include all costs and weigh complexity.
search: Reassess the historical 5%/10% search gate as a practical opportunity test. A small credible gain may justify further bounded work; a substantial ladder regression does not establish a remaining chain-quality opportunity.
preserved: All source hashes, certified inputs, candidate arms, bounds, budgets, seeds, samples, instability extensions and historical protocol fields remain frozen. No held-out retuning.
